SignalingTSNE

Source: R/SignalingTSNE.R
SignalingTSNE.Rd

Experimental function for visualizing signaling in t-SNE space. This function is currently under development and not yet fully implemented.

Usage

SignalingTSNE(
  object,
  mechanisms,
  sending.cells = NULL,
  receiving.cells = NULL,
  plot.centroids = TRUE,
  plot.trajectories = TRUE,
  plot.forces = FALSE,
  output.gif = FALSE,
  ...
)

Arguments

object

A Seurat object.

mechanisms

A data.frame of signaling mechanisms with ligand and receptor columns.

sending.cells

Cells to consider for ligand expression. Default: all cells.

receiving.cells

Cells to consider for receptor expression. Default: all cells.

plot.centroids

Whether to plot centroids. Default: TRUE

plot.trajectories

Whether to plot trajectories. Default: TRUE

plot.forces

Whether to plot force vectors. Default: FALSE

output.gif

Whether to output a GIF. Default: FALSE

...

Additional parameters.

Value

NULL (function not yet implemented)
